requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the energy class must be A1, A2, A3, A4, B or C. Area, capacity and location criteria are outside the available columns and are not included.

The property will be a university student residence, so schools and universities must be nearby. The user's purpose makes education access essential. Set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area must be at least 850.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the office property type, surface area of at least 850 sqm, energy classes A1 through C, and education score of at least 75. Geographic filter is a 3.0 km haversine radius around the supplied coordinates, and results are ordered by distance from that point.
